Running command: # Let me check if the system library's idn2_to_ascii_4i has the same vulnerability
# by looking at the binary
objdump -d /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libidn2.so.0.3.8 2>/dev/null | grep -A 100 "idn2_to_ascii_4i>:" | head -120

message.content: Let me try a different approach. Instead of building the whole library, I'll write a test harness that uses the system library but tests the vulnerable code path. The system library (2.3.3) has the fix, but let me check what the fix actually is:
